summary.goal: Rework PlansListPage to work with sidebar layout, add initiative filter, and support 'My Plans' vs 'All Plans' views
summary.context: Current PlansListPage has attention sections (Needs Attention, Working On) and All Plans with filter tabs. Keep this structure but: (1) remove page header (sidebar provides context), (2) add initiative dropdown filter, (3) split into My Plans (owner_user_id = current) vs All Plans routes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Route /plans shows all plans (All Plans view)
Route /plans/my shows only plans where owner_user_id matches current user
Initiative dropdown filter at top: 'All Initiatives' + list of initiatives
When initiative selected, only plans with that initiative_id shown
Status filter tabs remain: All, Draft, Approved, Published
Search input remains, searches goal and scope
Attention sections (Needs Attention, Working On) shown at top when relevant
Plan cards show initiative badge (icon + name) if assigned
New Plan button in content area (not just sidebar)
Page header removed (workspace context is in sidebar)
View mode toggle (list/grouped) remains

design_spec.approach: Evolve existing PlansListPage, remove page header, add initiative filter

views.name: All Plans / My Plans
views.layout: full width content area, two-row toolbar at top

elements.props: existing list with initiative badge added

elements.use: goal, status, step count, updated time

views.name: Compact Filter Bar
views.layout: flex row, justify-between, items-center, gap-4, mb-4
views.notes: Left: initiative Select + status ToggleGroup. Right: view mode toggle + New Plan button

changes_from_current: Remove <header> with 'Plans' title and description (sidebar provides context)
Add InitiativeBadge to PlanCard when initiative_id is set
Make attention sections more compact (smaller cards)
custom_needed: InitiativeBadge - small inline badge with initiative icon + name
FilterBar - composed toolbar for all filter controls

steps.title: Extend PlanSummary type with initiative fields
steps.description: Update src/types.ts to include initiative_id and initiative object in PlanSummary. The backend (schema-org-initiative) returns plans with initiative_id and nested initiative: { name, icon, color } when set.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanSummary interface includes initiative_id?: string
PlanSummary interface includes initiative?: { name: string; icon?: string; color?: string }
PlanSummary interface includes owner_user_id?: string

steps.title: Update listPlans API to support initiative filter
steps.description: Update src/api/index.ts listPlans() function to accept optional initiative_id query param. Backend endpoint GET /plans?initiative_id=xxx is provided by schema-org-initiative.

acceptance_criteria.description: listPlans(params?: { initiative_id?: string; owner_user_id?: string }) signature updated
Query params appended to URL when provided
Returns PlanSummary[] with initiative data included

steps.title: Create InitiativeBadge component
steps.description: Create src/components/InitiativeBadge.tsx - a small inline badge showing initiative icon + name. Uses muted colors, small text. Displayed on PlanCard when plan has initiative_id.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeBadge accepts { initiative: { name: string; icon?: string; color?: string } } props
Displays color dot (using initiative.color or default) + name
Styled: inline-flex, text-xs, text-text-muted, bg-bg-tertiary/50, rounded, px-1.5 py-0.5
Color dot is 6x6 rounded-full with initiative.color as bg or accent-purple default

steps.title: Update PlanCard to show InitiativeBadge
steps.description: Modify src/components/PlanCard.tsx to render InitiativeBadge when plan.initiative is present. Place badge in the metadata row (after scopes, before version).

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanCard renders InitiativeBadge when plan.initiative is defined
Badge positioned in metadata row between scopes and version
Separator dot appears before badge when scopes exist
No badge or extra space when plan.initiative is undefined

steps.title: Create InitiativeTabs component
steps.description: Create src/components/InitiativeTabs.tsx - horizontal scrollable pills for filtering by initiative. Shows 'All' + list of initiatives. Uses catalog design_system two_row_toolbar pattern for row2 filter tabs.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeTabs accepts { initiatives: Initiative[]; selected: string | null; onSelect: (id: string | null) => void } props
'All' pill is first, clicking it calls onSelect(null)
Each initiative rendered as pill with color dot + name
Selected pill has bg-bg-elevated, text-text-primary, shadow-sm
Unselected pills have text-text-muted, hover:text-text-secondary
Container scrolls horizontally on overflow, hides scrollbar

steps.title: Create PlansToolbar component
steps.description: Create src/components/PlansToolbar.tsx implementing two_row_toolbar pattern. Row1: breadcrumb (Plans/My Plans) + New Plan button. Row2: InitiativeTabs + status ToggleGroup + view mode toggle. Layout per catalog.design_system.patterns.two_row_toolbar.

acceptance_criteria.description: Row1 layout: flex justify-between items-center h-12 px-4 border-b border-border-subtle
Row1 left: 'Plans' or 'My Plans' text (font-display text-lg font-semibold)
Row1 right: + New Plan button (Link to /plans/new, primary style)
Row2 layout: flex justify-between items-center h-12 px-4 gap-4
Row2 left: InitiativeTabs
Row2 right: status ToggleGroup + view mode ToggleGroup
PlansToolbar accepts props: { title, initiatives, selectedInitiative, onInitiativeSelect, statusFilter, onStatusChange, viewMode, onViewModeChange }

steps.title: Create usePlansFilter hook
steps.description: Create src/hooks/usePlansFilter.ts to manage filter state: initiative, status, search query. Syncs with URL query params for shareable filter links. Persists view mode to localStorage.

acceptance_criteria.description: usePlansFilter() returns { initiative, status, search, viewMode, setInitiative, setStatus, setSearch, setViewMode }
initiative and status synced to URL query params (?initiative=xxx&status=draft)
viewMode persisted to localStorage (existing usePlansViewMode logic can be merged)
Search query is local state only (not in URL)
Hook exported from src/hooks/index.ts

steps.title: Create useCurrentUser hook (stub)
steps.description: Create src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts that returns current user context. For v1, return a hardcoded user_id since auth is not implemented. This enables the My Plans filter to work.

acceptance_criteria.description: useCurrentUser() returns { user_id: string; name?: string }
For v1, returns { user_id: 'default-user' } as placeholder
TODO comment notes: 'Replace with actual auth context when implemented'
Hook exported from src/hooks/index.ts

steps.title: Add /plans/my route to router
steps.description: Update src/App.tsx (or routes file) to add /plans/my route that renders PlansListPage with isMyPlans=true prop.

acceptance_criteria.description: Route /plans/my exists and renders PlansListPage
PlansListPage receives isMyPlans prop from route
Route /plans continues to work (isMyPlans=false or undefined)

steps.title: Refactor PlansListPage to use new components
steps.description: Refactor src/pages/PlansListPage.tsx: (1) Remove header section entirely, (2) Add PlansToolbar at top, (3) Use usePlansFilter hook, (4) Fetch initiatives using useInitiatives, (5) Filter plans by initiative_id when selected, (6) Filter by owner_user_id when isMyPlans=true.

acceptance_criteria.description: Header section (lines 93-113 current) removed completely
PlansToolbar rendered at top of page content
Initiatives fetched with useInitiatives hook
Plans filtered by selected initiative_id (client-side or via API param)
When isMyPlans=true, plans filtered by owner_user_id === currentUser.user_id
PlansToolbar title shows 'Plans' or 'My Plans' based on isMyPlans
All existing functionality preserved: attention sections, status filter, search, view mode toggle

steps.title: Add search input to PlansToolbar
steps.description: Move search input into PlansToolbar as a third element in row2 (right side, before view mode toggle), or keep it below toolbar. Design decision: keep below toolbar for now since row2 is already dense.

acceptance_criteria.description: Search input rendered below toolbar, full width, with left padding matching content
Search icon prefix, placeholder 'Search plans...'
Clear button appears when search has value
Search filters displayPlans as before (existing fuzzy search logic)

steps.title: Make attention sections more compact
steps.description: Update NeedsAttentionSection and WorkingOnSection to be more compact per design_spec. Smaller padding, tighter spacing. This allows more content above the fold.

acceptance_criteria.description: NeedsAttentionSection cards have reduced padding (py-2.5 instead of py-4)
Section header is smaller (text-sm instead of text-base)
Gap between cards reduced (gap-2 instead of gap-3)
WorkingOnSection follows same compact styling

steps.title: Write tests for new components
steps.description: Add tests for InitiativeBadge, InitiativeTabs, PlansToolbar, usePlansFilter. Cover rendering, interactions, and state management.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeBadge.test.tsx: renders name and color dot, handles missing color
InitiativeTabs.test.tsx: renders All + initiatives, calls onSelect with correct id
PlansToolbar.test.tsx: renders both rows, buttons work
usePlansFilter.test.ts: manages state, syncs URL params
All tests pass: npm run test

steps.description: Update existing PlansListPage tests to account for removed header, new toolbar, and initiative filtering. Ensure tests still pass with new structure.
